items.summary: Add a comprehensive Ramayan full katha entry to the backend Katha data store. The entry must include: title 'Ramayan - Sampurna Katha', category 'Puranik', deity 'Ram', full Hindi narrative text covering all major episodes (Bal Kand: Ram's birth and childhood, Ayodhya Kand: exile decision, Aranya Kand: forest life and Sita's abduction by Ravan, Kishkindha Kand: alliance with Sugriva and Hanuman, Sundar Kand: Hanuman's Lanka mission, Lanka Kand/Yuddha Kand: the war and Ravan's defeat, Uttar Kand: return to Ayodhya and Ram Rajya), and an English summary. The entry should appear before Mahabharat in ordering.

Add a comprehensive Mahabharat full katha entry to the backend Katha data store after the Ramayan entry. The entry must include: title 'Mahabharat - Sampurna Katha', category 'Puranik', deity 'Krishna', full Hindi narrative text covering all major parvas (Adi Parva: origins and Pandava birth, Sabha Parva: dice game and exile, Vana Parva: forest exile, Virata Parva, Udyoga Parva: war preparations, Bhishma/Drona/Karna/Shalya Parvas: the 18-day Kurukshetra war, Stri/Shanti/Anushasana Parvas, Ashvamedha Parva, and the Swargarohana Parva), and an English summary.

Update the static fallback katha data in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts to include both the Ramayan full katha and Mahabharat full katha entries (matching the backend data structure) so the Kathayen page renders them correctly even when the backend returns no results. Ramayan must appear before Mahabharat.
